[3] cakkhuṃ bhikkhave anattā yadanattā taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ . sotaṃ anattā .pe. ghānaṃ anattā . jivhā anattā . kāyo anattā .
